header.status: In development · Vetus Rex — The Origin

home.subtitle: We're an independent studio from Argentina. We've been playing since we were kids, and now we put that same excitement into making our own games.

featured.title: Vetus Rex — The Origin
featured.description: Step into a vast, unexplored world and uncover the secrets hidden within the enigmatic lands of the Old King. Rise as the hero who will shape the fate of the world as we know it. Are you ready?

about.title: Who we are
about.lead: At Tiki-Tiki Studios we've been playing video games all our lives, and at some point we wanted to start making our own. We can tell when a game has been made with care, and that's how we approach every project.

values.title: We're players
values.text: We play a bit of everything and always have. A lot of what we design comes from there.

values.title: Made with care
values.text: We take time over the details that make a game enjoyable to play.

values.title: Our own ideas
values.text: Every project starts from an idea that excites us, whatever the genre.
